exposure: Surgical evacuation of uterus after abortion
cohort: Nulliparous women in Finland with their first pregnancy ending in induced abortion between 2000-2015 and subsequent pregnancy with live singleton delivery between 2000 and 2017
finding: First- or second-trimester medical abortion does not increase the odds for fear of childbirth, and cesarean delivery related to it in subsequent pregnancy when compared with first-trimester surgical abortion.
gest_age: First trimester (≤84 days of gestation) or second trimester (85-168 days of gestation)
